The '''Department of Health''' was an organization of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It was influential in dealing with a [[Death Seed]] pandemic on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]. It was reorganized in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]] as the [[Galactic Alliance Department of Health]].
